findings.message: 4 eyebrow/kicker label(s) above headings: "4 de 4 tiendas abiertas ahora" above "Variedades Dayana"; "Útiles escolares" (pill) above "Útiles escolares"; "Cuadernos para la temporada" (pill) above "Oficina"; "Una vitrina de pan dulce" (pill) above "La tiendita"
findings.fix: Delete them. If the label carried real information, fold it into the headline or the supporting sentence.
Remove them. If order truly matters, write it into the words ("First, …") or use a real <ol>.

findings.message: 1 gradient fill(s): span.d-story__scrim → linear-gradient(90deg, rgba(0, 24, 74, 0.94) 0%, rgba(0, 24, 74, 0.82) 36%, rgba(0, 24, 74, 0) 62%)
findings.fix: Use a flat colour or a real image. The only gradient allowed by default is a neutral scrim over a photo for legibility.

findings.message: 1 row(s) of identical cards each topped with a small icon (4 cards).
findings.fix: Replace with one composed section from the direction: a narrative split, a list set in large type, or real imagery per item.
A page needs about five: display, heading, lead, body, small.

findings.message: Body text is 14px (the size most of the running text is set in).
findings.fix: Body copy 16–20px. Map small sizes from blueprints onto your body step.

findings.message: No video anywhere on the page.
findings.fix: Look for one honest clip with scripts/assets.mjs --video (the place, the material, the process) and use it as a muted loop with a poster frame. Defend its absence only if no clip fits the subject.

findings.message: This page is served by a development server (Vite, webpack or Next in dev mode).
findings.fix: Run the last gate on the production build too (vite build && vite preview, next build && next start, or the built index.html): minifiers and bundlers change the CSS a visitor receives.

findings.message: 3 stretch(es) of the page hold nothing at all: 2108px at 11980px; 392px at 15156px; 396px at 17052px (the screen is 900px tall).
findings.fix: Close the gap: a section gap is 120–240px on desktop and 72–112px on a phone. Look for a min-height: 100vh on a short section, an empty grid row, a hidden element still holding its space, or a reveal that never fired. A deliberate rest is a placed picture or colour field, not nothing.

findings.message: Large text lies under another element at some scroll position: "2010" (screen 8, 100% hidden); "Un cuarto de la casa" (screen 8, 100% hidden); "Las vitrinas" (screen 8, 100% hidden); "Lo que era un extra" (screen 8, 100% hidden)
findings.fix: Nothing may sit on top of a headline or statement. Move the picture, shorten the pinned run, or raise the text above it (z-index) and give it a ground.

findings.message: Pinned large text slides across pictures while the page scrolls: "Esta historia cabe en un cuarto" (screen 7, 100% over a picture); "2010" (screen 8, 100% over a picture); "Las vitrinas" (screen 8, 100% over a picture)
findings.fix: Jurors read a pinned title crossing drawings or photographs as a collision. Keep the pictures in the column the title does not occupy, or unpin it.

findings.message: The same large text stays on screen for 6 screens in a row: "Esta historia cabe en un cuarto"; "2010"
findings.fix: A pinned element earns two screens, and something must change at each. Shorten the run or give every screen its own content.
